about: Modelled read-back of the WGEX admin right (rightDefinition, as `security authorizationdb read <right>` returns it) and of its delegate authenticate-admin-nonshared (delegateDefinition). authd stores a rule-class right without shared or timeout; the delegate's timeout decides the daemon recheck. Shapes follow the macOS 26.6.2 (25G83) guest probe of 7 November 2026; created, modified, identifier and requirement are creator metadata. M03-T11 compares class, rule, shared and timeout with macOS 27.

rightDefinition.comment: WGEX administrator authorisation; authenticate-admin-nonshared, not shared, 30 seconds
